common_rules.candidate_universe: One frozen property snapshot per benchmark version; every method receives the same profile-specific starting universe.
common_rules.mandatory_eligibility: Apply data validity, approved status, availability, property type, budget flexibility, bedroom, bathroom, size, furnishing, move-in, and must-have amenity rules unless a named intervention explicitly removes one.
common_rules.routing: Use the same frozen OSRM matrix whenever a method requires routes; no method may query live routing during evaluation.
common_rules.short_output_policy: Do not pad results. Missing ranks contribute zero gain and precision uses fixed K; report coverage and empty-result rate.
common_rules.ties: Resolve ties by stable frozen listing identifier ascending after method-specific keys.

baselines.name: Seeded random ranking
baselines.candidate_selection: All mandatory-eligible properties; enforce commute constraints only in the route-aware random comparison stratum.
baselines.ordering: Uniform random permutation using 1000 trials with trial seed 42 + trial_index.
baselines.top_k_policy: Return first 10 or all available when fewer than 10.
baselines.purpose: Estimate chance-level ranking while preserving eligibility.
baselines.notes: Report mean and interval across trials before profile aggregation.

baselines.name: Conventional filtering-only
baselines.candidate_selection: All mandatory-eligible properties without KNN or WSM.
baselines.ordering: Published/created timestamp descending, then frozen listing identifier ascending; missing timestamps sort last.
baselines.top_k_policy: Return first 10 or all available when fewer than 10.
baselines.purpose: Represent a deterministic portal that filters but does not personalize ranking.

baselines.name: Area-first rental search
baselines.candidate_selection: Apply mandatory eligibility, then prioritize the profile's independently declared conventional preferred micro-area, followed by its broad area, then outside-area properties.
baselines.ordering: Area tier ascending; absolute distance from advertised rent to the profile maximum budget ascending; timestamp descending; identifier ascending.
baselines.top_k_policy: Return first 10 or all available when fewer than 10.
baselines.purpose: Operationalize ordinary neighborhood-first discovery without deriving the neighborhood from DhakaNest rankings or labels.
baselines.notes: Every benchmark profile must declare an area-first neighborhood before annotation.

baselines.name: Content-Based KNN only
baselines.candidate_selection: Apply mandatory eligibility and the common route/commute policy, then use the production content feature space and configured K=10.
baselines.ordering: Cosine property-similarity descending, then identifier ascending.
baselines.top_k_policy: Return the selected KNN shortlist, up to 10.
baselines.purpose: Measure similarity ordering without WSM reranking.

baselines.name: WSM only without KNN shortlist
baselines.candidate_selection: Apply mandatory eligibility, routing, maximum-commute constraints, and destination scoring; pass every survivor to WSM.
baselines.ordering: WSM v4 final suitability descending, then identifier ascending.
baselines.purpose: Measure WSM ranking without KNN candidate restriction.

baselines.name: KNN plus WSM without destination awareness
baselines.candidate_selection: Apply non-route mandatory eligibility and production KNN; do not use destination coordinates, route scores, or commute limits.
baselines.ordering: WSM over budget, space, amenities, and rent fairness with their original priority values renormalized to sum to one; identifier breaks ties.
baselines.purpose: Provide a commute-agnostic hybrid control without granting a neutral location bonus.

baselines.name: KNN plus WSM without Rent Fairness
baselines.candidate_selection: Use the same candidates and KNN shortlist as the full method.
baselines.ordering: WSM over location, budget, space, and amenities with original priorities renormalized; identifier breaks ties.

baselines.name: Full DhakaNest WSM v4
baselines.candidate_selection: Production hard filters, frozen OSRM commute processing and constraints, destination-access scoring, then production content KNN with configured K=10.
baselines.ordering: Production five-criterion WSM v4, then production property-similarity and stable input-order tie handling.
baselines.top_k_policy: Return the production KNN-limited ranked output, up to 10.
baselines.purpose: Reference treatment representing the unchanged implemented framework.
